_comment: Expected Traffic Path verdicts, transcribed from the live policy on 7 Sep 2026.
action: accept | drop | null (recorded, never judged)
Rule numbers are deliberately NOT asserted - they shift on every insert.
Destinations use the real object addresses: RDP-Server is .20.100 (not .20.10)
and Web-Server is .20.20. Getting those wrong is what made the first run fail.

External-FW.name: VLAN20 CANNOT reach the RDP server
External-FW.why: rule 5 source is VLAN10 + Net-Corp only

External-FW.name: VLAN10 CANNOT reach AD over LDAP
External-FW.why: rule 4 source is VLAN20 + Net-Corp + Vlan33

External-FW.name: Lab hosts reach the web server
Lab hosts CANNOT SMB into the corporate VLAN
The internet CANNOT reach a lab client
VLAN20 to AD on an unmodelled high port
External-FW.why: AD-Services contains ALL_DCE_RPC, whose ports are negotiated at runtime - the honest answer is unknown, not drop

Internal-FW.name: anything is permitted (single Allow-Any rule)
Internal-FW.why: the package has one rule: Any/Any/Any Accept. This case exists to make that visible, not to endorse it.
